title: Deep Learning Practice
standfirst: Applied deep learning — training tricks, debugging, transfer learning and shipping a model to production.
instructor: Prof. Mitesh Khapra, Prof. S. Umesh & Prof. Kaushik Mitra

description_paragraphs: This course introduces modern NLP using transformers and the Hugging Face ecosystem, covering datasets, tokenization, and fine-tuning of pre-trained models for downstream tasks. It includes advanced topics such as continual pre-training, instruction tuning, and efficient training techniques. The course also extends to multimodal applications, including speech processing (speaker identification, speech-to-text, wake word detection) and computer vision tasks such as image classification, object detection, depth estimation, and image super-resolution, with hands-on experience on real-world datasets and challenges.
faculty: Prof. Mitesh Khapra, Wadhwani School of Data Science, IIT Madras
Prof. S. Umesh, Department of Electrical Engineering, IIT Madras
Prof. Kaushik Mitra, Department of Electrical Engineering, IIT Madras

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Modern NLP with transformers; Hugging Face ecosystem (datasets, tokenizers, models, trainers); Dataset loading, processing, and streaming.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Tokenization techniques; Tokenizer pipeline (normalization, pre-tokenization, encoding/decoding); Training custom tokenizers.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Fine-tuning transformer models; Task-specific adaptation; Parameter-efficient vs full fine-tuning; Evaluation metrics.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Pre-training and instruction tuning; CLM/MLM objectives; Efficient training (mixed precision, checkpointing); PEFT methods (LoRA, QLoRA).

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Spoken language identification; Audio-based classification tasks.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Speaker diarization; Identifying speakers and segmentation in conversations.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Speech processing; Speech-to-text (ASR) and text-to-speech (TTS) systems.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Wake-word detection; Personalized keyword spotting systems.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Image classification; CNN architectures (AlexNet, VGG, ResNet, DenseNet, ViT); Dataset challenges (variation, imbalance).

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Object detection; Models (YOLO, R-CNN); Handling real-world datasets and class imbalance.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Depth estimation from images; Models (U-Net, Pix2Pix); Challenges like low-light conditions.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Image super-resolution; GAN-based methods (SRGAN); Applications to medical imaging.
